movelist.name: Synthesis
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value instead. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value instead.

movelist.name: Toxic
movelist.effect: The target is Badly Poisoned. If the user is Poison Type, Toxic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Giga Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Ingrain
movelist.effect: Ingrain applies a Coat to the user, which has the following effect; the user cannot be pushed or pulled, and cannot be switched out.  At the beginning of each of the user’s turn, the user gains a Tick of Hit Points.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack
abilities.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the attacker is Poisoned. On a result of 3 or 4, the attacker is Paralyzed. On a result of 5 or 6, the attacker falls Asleep.

abilities.name: Spinning Dance
abilities.trigger: The user is targeted by an attack, but is missed
abilities.effect: If not Fainted, Paralyzed, or Asleep, the user gains +1 Evasion and may immediately Shift 1 meter.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.trigger: The user is recalled into a Poké Ball, or Takes
abilities.effect: The user gains Hit Points equal to 1/3rd of its maximum Hit Points. Regenerator may be activated only once per Scene.
